title: arch-diagram EA model
description: One model per solution, in one framework. Every view and export is drawn from it. This schema checks structure; ealib.validate() checks the framework's rules (types, id prefixes, which relationships may join which types, BPMN flow rules).

metamodel.description: Defaults to coreea when absent (1.x model files).

id.description: Stable across views and revisions. ArchiMate, TOGAF and Essential ids start with the type's prefix (ACMP-01, PAC-CRM); `ea.py types <metamodel>` lists them.

type.description: A type of the chosen metamodel.

name.description: Required except on BPMN events, gateways and lanes, and ArchiMate junctions.

status.description: Proposed / Designed / Not started draw dashed.

owner.description: An organisation or role from the source documents. Never invented.

ref.description: The source document's own id (FR-04, SEC-RISK-02).

parent.description: TOGAF / Essential / CoreEA: an object of the same type this is part of. BPMN: the lane, pool or sub-process it sits in. Not used in ArchiMate (nest with relationships).

category.description: Free classification shown as a sub-line, e.g. Confidential.

doc.description: Section of the design document that describes the object.

sad.description: CoreEA: SAD section that describes the object (same as doc).

properties.description: Further attributes; exported as ArchiMate properties, CSV columns and Orbus attributes when mapped.

attachedTo.description: BPMN boundary event: the activity it sits on.

interrupting.description: BPMN boundary event; false draws dashed.

timer.description: BPMN timer event: ISO 8601 duration such as P5D.

collapsed.description: BPMN sub-process / call activity drawn collapsed (default true).

id.description: Optional; derived from from-type-to when absent.

type.description: ArchiMate relationship (serving, realization …), TOGAF, Essential or CoreEA verb, or BPMN connector (sequenceFlow, messageFlow, association, dataInput, dataOutput).

crud.description: Essential 'uses information': which of create, read, update, delete.
